task.name: stack_three_block
task.description: Use the left arm to stack the orange block on top of the green block, then use the right arm to stack the blue block on top of the orange block.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the orange block.
2. Grasp the orange block with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the green block.
4. Release the gripper to stack the orange block on top of the green block.
5. Move the right arm to approach and align with the blue block.
6. Grasp the blue block with the right arm.
7. Move the right arm to align with the orange block.
8. Release the gripper to stack the blue block on top of the orange block.
